newsitem.title: USA: U.S. reserve assets fell in February.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reserve assets fell in February.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Friday that U.S. reserve assets fell $721 million in February to $67.48 billion from $68.20 billion in January.
The department said U.S. holdings of foreign currencies were down to $32.53 billion in February from $32.99 billion in January.
Gold stock totaled $11.05 billion in both months.
Special Drawing Right with the International Monetary Fund rose to $9.87 billion in February from $9.79 billion.
The value of the U.S. reserve position with the IMF fell to $14.04 billion in February from $14.37 billion in January.
